To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 16-flashing paradigm is the best paradigm for P300 BCIs and it is better than RC (19-flash).
the optimized 16-flash pattern can significantly improve the bit rate of a P300 BCCI.
the 16-flash pattern was the most effective pattern for the P300 BCI.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a P300-based BCI system with the goal of maximizing the information transfer rate.
the development and evaluation of optimized stimulus presentation patterns for the design of P300 BCI systems.
the development of a new paradigm for a P300-based BCI system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best pattern is the one that is optimized for the individual subject.
the 16-flash pattern can be recommended as the best paradigm for online BCI systems.
the best performance is achieved when the 16-flash pattern and the best subject-specific paradigm are used.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have presented a novel paradigmatic approach to flashing characters for P300 BCI and we have demonstrated that the optimized paradigm can improve the bit rate of P300 BCI.
the 16-flash pattern was the best paradigm for most subjects.
the 16-flash pattern can be used for online P300 BCTs with a bit rate of about 2 bits/min.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the number of flashes per trial can be significantly reduced (from 19 to 12) without a loss in performance.
the number of flashes required to identify a target can be reduced significantly by using a new optimized paradigm.
it is possible to improve the practical bit rate of a P300 BCCI without compromising accuracy.
